author: Inside Edition
description: The tense search for Savannah Guthrie's mother is increasingly desperate with the purported kidnapper's final deadline passing on Monday at 5 p.m. Law enforcement returned to Nancy Guthrie's Tucson home over the weekend, searching the septic tank for items abductors may have flushed. Activity was also observed on the roof. Investigators removed a camera and a solar panel. Inside Edition spoke with former FBI special agent Lance Leising.
title: Authorities Investigate Roof Of Nancy Guthrie's Home

author: Inside Edition
description: Savannah Guthrie stuck a somber tone in her new 20-second video message to her mother's kidnappers. She did not read from a script. It was recorded after Nancy Guthrie's three children reportedly received a new message from the person claiming to be the kidnapper. Criminologist Casey Jordan says she believes the Guthrie siblings are resigned to the grim realization that their mother may be dead. Former FBI special agent Jennifer Coffindaffer agrees.
title: Savannah Guthrie Posts New Appeal Video

author: Inside Edition
description: A polar bear on a therapist's sofa in a Pepsi Super Bowl ad is a Coca-Cola fan but in a blind taste test he chooses Pepsi Zero Sugar and can't believe it. Zoe Ruderman of Ad Week says it was one of the best commercials of Sunday night. This year Ben Affleck led a cast of famous sitcom stars in Dunkin's ad "Good Will Dunkin." It was star-studded with "Family Matters" star Jaleel White and "The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air" star Alfonso Ribeiro.
title: Best Super Bowl Ads This Year

author: Inside Edition
description: Brian Roush was in the Bahamas when he tripped and scraped his ankle. Roush continued with his vacation, thinking nothing about the cut. He later swam with pigs at a popular tourist attraction. When the vacation was over, Roush suddenly got violently sick. Within hours he was on life support in the hospital diagnosed with flesh-eating bacteria. The family set up a GoFundMe to support Roush's recovery. For further information about their GoFundMe, click this link: https://bit.ly/4qBV9Ve
title: Man Contracts Flesh-Eating Bacteria After Visiting Tourist Attraction

author: Inside Edition
description: Cesarina Johnson heard a buzz outside her window and started recording the Amazon delivery drone. The drone accidentally crashed into her apartment building in Richardson, Texas. Johnson spoke with Inside Edition. The drone was Amazon's new Prime Air drone. It weighs 80 pounds. The drone is equipped with cameras and promises fast same-day delivery. Amazon says they apologize for any inconvenience and that they are investigating this incident.
title: Amazon Delivery Drone Crashes Into Texas Apartment Building

author: Inside Edition
description: A little boy's memory is living on through his hobby. Billy was eight when he died after contracting the flu and developing a metabolic disorder. His family says Billy loved to paint rocks and leave them in public places for others to find and admire. They created a project called “Billy's Boulders” which encourages people all over the world to do the same thing. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 8-Year-Old's Memory Lives On Through Painted Rock Project

author: Inside Edition
description: Georgina Petridis, who is living with multiple sclerosis, is raising awareness and teaching others with chronic illnesses how to empower themselves.
title: 'I Was In Denial With My Diagnosis' #shorts
